regional_crop_agronomy_database.description: Expanded agronomic database of scientifically vetted, economically viable crops categorized by soil profile and district.

predominant_soil_types: Deep to Medium Black Soils (Vertisols / Vertic Haplustepts)
Coarse Shallow Mixed Red-Brown Soils (Lithic Ustorthents / Malran)
Alluvial Loams along the Krishna River Basin
districts.soil_chemical_profile: pH 7.6 - 8.4 (mildly to moderately alkaline), high CEC (35-50 cmol/kg), high potassium reserves, low available phosphorus (fixation via free CaCO3), low organic carbon (<0.45%), prone to Iron (Fe) and Zinc (Zn) deficiencies.

viable_recommended_crops.target_soil_type: Deep well-drained alluvial medium black loams

fertilizer_requirements.organic_manure: FYM @ 25 tonnes/ha or enriched pressmud @ 10 tonnes/ha
fertilizer_requirements.secondary_and_micronutrients: Ferrous Sulphate (FeSO4) @ 25 kg/ha + Zinc Sulphate (ZnSO4) @ 25 kg/ha basal; Elemental Sulphur @ 30 kg/ha
fertilizer_requirements.application_schedule_and_rationale: Basal: 100% P, 100% K, 33% N. Split top-dressing: 33% N at 45 DAP and 33% N at 90 DAP during earthing up. Micronutrients offset lime-induced chlorosis in high-pH Krishna river loams.

viable_recommended_crops.growing_season: Perennial (Foundation pruning: April; Fruit pruning: October)
viable_recommended_crops.target_soil_type: Gravelly light-to-medium black soils with EC < 1.0 dS/m and rapid drainage

fertilizer_requirements.organic_manure: Well-cured FYM @ 20 tonnes/ha or vermicompost @ 5 tonnes/ha post-October pruning
fertilizer_requirements.secondary_and_micronutrients: Magnesium Sulphate @ 30 kg/ha; Boron foliar spray (0.1%) pre-bloom; Zinc Sulphate @ 15 kg/ha
fertilizer_requirements.application_schedule_and_rationale: Vegetative phase (post-April): 40% N, 100% P, 30% K. Reproductive phase (post-October): 60% N, 70% K applied via drip fertigation from bud burst through veraison to maximize TSS accumulation.

viable_recommended_crops.target_soil_type: Deep moisture-retentive black Vertisols (Krishna valley)

fertilizer_requirements.organic_manure: FYM @ 25 tonnes/ha or pressmud cake @ 12 tonnes/ha
fertilizer_requirements.secondary_and_micronutrients: Zinc Sulphate @ 25 kg/ha, FeSO4 @ 25 kg/ha, Elemental Sulphur @ 40 kg/ha
fertilizer_requirements.application_schedule_and_rationale: 10% N, 50% P, 50% K at planting; 40% N at tillering (6-8 weeks); 10% N, 50% P, 50% K at mini-earthing up; 40% N at big earthing up (120-135 DAP).

viable_recommended_crops.growing_season: Perennial (Mrid Bahar: June flowering; Hasta Bahar: Sept-Oct flowering)
viable_recommended_crops.target_soil_type: Light, coarse gravelly soils with rapid sub-drainage (Atpadi, Jath, Kavathe Mahankal)

fertilizer_requirements.organic_manure: FYM @ 20 kg/tree + Neem cake @ 2 kg/tree during stress break
fertilizer_requirements.secondary_and_micronutrients: Solubor (Boron) @ 1.5 g/L and Zinc EDTA @ 1 g/L foliar spray during anthesis
fertilizer_requirements.application_schedule_and_rationale: 100% P and organic manures incorporated at defoliation; N and K fertigated weekly in splits until 30 days before harvest to prevent fruit splitting.

viable_recommended_crops.target_soil_type: Shallow, rocky, coarse gravelly soils (pH 6.5 - 8.2) with rapid drainage

fertilizer_requirements.recommended_npk_kg_per_ha: 150:100:150 (approx. 450:300:450 g N:P2O5:K2O per concrete pole/4 plants)
fertilizer_requirements.organic_manure: FYM @ 15 kg/pole + Vermicompost @ 5 kg/pole annually in three splits
fertilizer_requirements.secondary_and_micronutrients: Magnesium Sulphate @ 50 g/pole; Calcium Nitrate @ 50 g/pole to enhance fruit firmness
fertilizer_requirements.application_schedule_and_rationale: Split into four intervals: pre-flowering (April), fruit development (June, August), and post-harvest maintenance (October). Avoid excessive nitrogen during monsoon flushes to prevent cladode rot.

viable_recommended_crops.target_soil_type: Medium black soils with adequate subsoil aeration (Walwa, Shirala, Miraj)

fertilizer_requirements.secondary_and_micronutrients: Bentonite Sulphur @ 25 kg/ha (or Gypsum @ 200 kg/ha)
fertilizer_requirements.application_schedule_and_rationale: Entire N, P, K, and Sulphur applied 5 cm beside and below the seed line at sowing. Sulphur drives oil synthesis and protein content.

viable_recommended_crops.target_soil_type: Medium to deep black soils retaining post-monsoon subsoil moisture

fertilizer_requirements.organic_manure: Rhizobium + PSB seed inoculants @ 250 g/10 kg seed
fertilizer_requirements.secondary_and_micronutrients: Sulphur @ 20 kg/ha
fertilizer_requirements.application_schedule_and_rationale: 100% basal placement at 8-10 cm depth. Low nitrogen encourages native atmospheric nitrogen fixation.

viable_recommended_crops.target_soil_type: Well-drained light to medium black clay loams

fertilizer_requirements.secondary_and_micronutrients: Calcium Nitrate @ 15 kg/ha; Zinc Sulphate @ 15 kg/ha basal; Boron foliar spray @ 0.1% at flowering
fertilizer_requirements.application_schedule_and_rationale: 50% N + 100% PK basal; remaining 50% N split at 30 and 50 days after transplanting (DAT). Boron prevents flower drop under high summer thermal stress.

viable_recommended_crops.target_soil_type: Well-drained medium black loams and silt loams

fertilizer_requirements.secondary_and_micronutrients: Zinc Sulphate @ 20 kg/ha basal (prevents 'white bud' physiological deficiency in alkaline soils)
fertilizer_requirements.application_schedule_and_rationale: 33% N + 100% PK basal; 33% N top-dressed at knee-high stage (30 DAS); 33% N top-dressed at tasseling stage (50-55 DAS).

viable_recommended_crops.target_soil_type: Medium black alluvial loams (minimum 60 cm depth) with zero waterlogging risk

fertilizer_requirements.recommended_npk_kg_per_ha: 200g N : 200g P2O5 : 250g K2O per plant/year (~500:500:625 kg/ha equivalent)
fertilizer_requirements.secondary_and_micronutrients: Borax @ 5 g/plant foliar (prevents bumpy fruit deformity); Zinc Sulphate @ 10 g/plant
fertilizer_requirements.application_schedule_and_rationale: Applied bimonthly in 6 equal splits starting from the 2nd month post-transplanting. High potassium maintains fruit firmness, skin integrity, and Brix value.

predominant_soil_types: Acidic Lateritic and Red Loamy Soils (Typic Hapludox / Mahabaleshwar, Patan, Jawali)
Medium to Deep Black Clay Soils (Typic Haplustepts / Vertisols / Karad, Satara plain)
Shallow Gravelly Calcareous Soils (Lithic Ustorthents / Maan, Khatav, Phaltan)
districts.soil_chemical_profile: Western sub-zone: acidic (pH 4.8 - 6.2), rich in iron/aluminum oxides, low available phosphorus (chemically fixed), low calcium and magnesium. Central/Eastern sub-zone: neutral to alkaline (pH 7.2 - 8.3), high potassium, low nitrogen, prone to subsoil compaction and sodicity.

viable_recommended_crops.target_soil_type: Lateritic red sandy clay loams (pH 5.5 - 6.5, Mahabaleshwar, Wai)

fertilizer_requirements.organic_manure: Composted leaf mold or FYM @ 30 tonnes/ha into raised beds
fertilizer_requirements.secondary_and_micronutrients: Agricultural Lime/Dolomite @ 2 tonnes/ha basal (corrects soil acidity); Calcium Nitrate @ 50 kg/ha via drip; Boron @ 0.1% foliar
fertilizer_requirements.application_schedule_and_rationale: Basal SSP applied to beds. Early fertigation at 1:2 N:K ratio during runner development, shifting to 1:3 N:K during flower truss initiation to maximize crown and berry size.

viable_recommended_crops.target_soil_type: Medium black soils with adequate aeration (Karad, Koregaon, Satara)

fertilizer_requirements.secondary_and_micronutrients: Bentonite Sulphur @ 25 kg/ha or Gypsum @ 200 kg/ha
fertilizer_requirements.application_schedule_and_rationale: 100% of nutrients banded 5 cm beside and below the seed furrow at sowing. Sulphur drives oil content and nodule efficiency.

viable_recommended_crops.target_soil_type: Deep moisture-retentive black Vertisols along the Krishna and Koyna river basins

fertilizer_requirements.organic_manure: FYM @ 30 tonnes/ha or decomposed bagasse compost @ 15 tonnes/ha
fertilizer_requirements.secondary_and_micronutrients: Zinc Sulphate @ 25 kg/ha, FeSO4 @ 25 kg/ha, Sulphur @ 50 kg/ha
fertilizer_requirements.application_schedule_and_rationale: 10% N, 50% PK basal; 40% N at tillering; 10% N, 50% PK at 100 days; 40% N at final earthing up (140-160 days).

viable_recommended_crops.target_soil_type: Humus-rich red-laterite or gravelly medium black loams (Wai, Jawali, Satara)

fertilizer_requirements.organic_manure: FYM @ 30 tonnes/ha + Neem cake @ 2 tonnes/ha (suppresses root rot complex)
fertilizer_requirements.secondary_and_micronutrients: Zinc Sulphate @ 25 kg/ha, Borax @ 10 kg/ha; Trichoderma-enriched FYM @ 2.5 tonnes/ha
fertilizer_requirements.application_schedule_and_rationale: 50% P and 50% K basal at planting. Nitrogen split across 40, 80, and 120 DAP, coordinated with hand-weeding and earthing up.

viable_recommended_crops.growing_season: Kharif (Sowing: June; Harvest: Sept) & Rabi (Sowing: Oct-Nov; Harvest: Jan-Feb)
viable_recommended_crops.target_soil_type: Friable, light well-aerated sandy loams and red loams (Khatav, Koregaon)

fertilizer_requirements.secondary_and_micronutrients: Magnesium Sulphate @ 25 kg/ha; Zinc Sulphate @ 15 kg/ha
fertilizer_requirements.application_schedule_and_rationale: 50% N + 100% P + 50% K placed in furrows before planting; remaining 50% N and 50% K applied during earthing up (30-35 DAP).

viable_recommended_crops.growing_season: Kharif (Nursery: June; Transplanting: July; Harvest: Oct-Nov)
viable_recommended_crops.target_soil_type: Shallow, gravelly, acidic red and lateritic hillside soils (Patan, Jawali, Mahabaleshwar foothills)

fertilizer_requirements.secondary_and_micronutrients: Zinc Sulphate @ 15 kg/ha; Lime @ 500 kg/ha in high acidity zones
fertilizer_requirements.application_schedule_and_rationale: 50% N + 100% PK at transplanting; remaining 50% N top-dressed 3 weeks after transplanting. Tolerates poor nutrient-holding capacity of leached laterites.

viable_recommended_crops.target_soil_type: Light to medium textured, well-drained loams (pH 6.0 - 7.5, Wai, Khandala)

fertilizer_requirements.recommended_npk_kg_per_ha: 90:60:60 (Phaseolus lacks native root nodulation; requires higher direct N)
fertilizer_requirements.secondary_and_micronutrients: Magnesium Sulphate @ 20 kg/ha; Molybdenum foliar spray @ 0.05%
fertilizer_requirements.application_schedule_and_rationale: 50% N + 100% PK basal; 50% N top-dressed at flowering initiation (30-35 DAS). Avoid waterlogging which causes immediate wilt.

viable_recommended_crops.target_soil_type: Deep clayey Vertisols retaining post-monsoon moisture (Maan, Phaltan)

fertilizer_requirements.secondary_and_micronutrients: Azotobacter and PSB seed treatments; Zinc Sulphate @ 15 kg/ha
fertilizer_requirements.application_schedule_and_rationale: For rainfed crops, 100% of NPK is placed 8-10 cm deep into moist soil at sowing to maximize root utilization before topsoil dries.

viable_recommended_crops.target_soil_type: Well-drained light sandy loams and friable red loams

fertilizer_requirements.secondary_and_micronutrients: Gypsum @ 400 kg/ha (applied 50% at sowing, 50% at pegging stage, 40-45 DAS)
fertilizer_requirements.application_schedule_and_rationale: Gypsum provides soluble Calcium in the pod zone, preventing shell pop (empty shells) and ensuring high seed oil synthesis.

viable_recommended_crops.growing_season: Kharif (Transplanting: July; Harvest: Sept-Oct for festival window) & Rabi (Oct to Jan)
viable_recommended_crops.target_soil_type: Well-aerated medium black soils and red loamy soils (Koregaon, Satara)

fertilizer_requirements.secondary_and_micronutrients: Boron foliar spray @ 0.1% at flower bud initiation (prevents blind bud and enhances petal count)
fertilizer_requirements.application_schedule_and_rationale: 50% N + 100% PK basal; 50% N top-dressed 30-35 DAT following pinch pruning (apical decapitation) to drive branch ramification.

predominant_soil_types: Medium to Deep Black Vertic Soils (Godavari, Girna, Kadva basins: Niphad, Sinnar, Yeola)
Brownish-Red Gravelly Soils / Forest Loams (Western Ghats: Igatpuri, Surgana, Peint)
Shallow Calcareous Clay Loams (Chandwad, Deola, Malegaon plateau)
districts.soil_chemical_profile: Central/Eastern tracts: neutral to alkaline (pH 7.5 - 8.3), high potassium reserves, low available P and N, high free calcium carbonate (CaCO3). Western tracts (Igatpuri): slightly acidic to neutral (pH 6.2 - 6.8), leached cations, low active salinity.

viable_recommended_crops.growing_season: Late Kharif (Rangada: Aug-Sept to Jan) & Rabi (Oct-Nov to April)
viable_recommended_crops.target_soil_type: Friable, deep, well-drained silty clay loams and medium black soils (Niphad, Kalwan)

fertilizer_requirements.secondary_and_micronutrients: Bentonite Sulphur @ 30-45 kg/ha; Zinc Sulphate @ 20 kg/ha
fertilizer_requirements.application_schedule_and_rationale: Basal: 33% N + 100% P + 100% K + 100% Sulphur. Remaining N split at 30 and 45 DAT. Nitrogen is halted strictly after 60 DAT to avoid thick necking, vegetative bolting, and storage rotting.

viable_recommended_crops.growing_season: Perennial (Foundation pruning: April; Fruit pruning: Sept-Oct)
viable_recommended_crops.target_soil_type: Gravelly loam to clay loam with sub-surface drainage gradient (Dindori, Niphad)

fertilizer_requirements.organic_manure: Composted farm manure @ 15 tonnes/ha or sheep manure @ 5 tonnes/ha
fertilizer_requirements.secondary_and_micronutrients: Magnesium Sulphate @ 40 kg/ha; Borax @ 10 kg/ha; Zinc Sulphate @ 20 kg/ha
fertilizer_requirements.application_schedule_and_rationale: Post-April pruning: nitrogen focus for cane growth. Post-October pruning: restricted nitrogen, staged phosphorus for flower induction, and progressive potassium fertigation (SOP) up to veraison to balance Brix and acidity.

viable_recommended_crops.growing_season: Kharif (June-July to Oct) & Rabi (Oct-Nov to Feb-March)
viable_recommended_crops.target_soil_type: Well-aerated medium black soils with high organic matter (Girna and Kadva plains)

fertilizer_requirements.secondary_and_micronutrients: Calcium Nitrate @ 25 kg/ha via drip (curbs Blossom End Rot); Borax @ 10 kg/ha basal
fertilizer_requirements.application_schedule_and_rationale: Basal: 50% N + 100% P + 50% K; remaining 50% N and 50% K fertigated weekly across the 10-week harvest cycle.

viable_recommended_crops.growing_season: Perennial (Ambe Bahar: Jan-Feb flowering; Mrid Bahar: June-July flowering)
viable_recommended_crops.target_soil_type: Light, gravelly, calcareous to sandy loam soils (Deola, Kalwan, Satana/Baglan)

fertilizer_requirements.secondary_and_micronutrients: Foliar Zinc EDTA (1 g/L) + Boric Acid (1.5 g/L) at full bloom
fertilizer_requirements.application_schedule_and_rationale: 100% P applied at defoliation/water release. N and K applied in weekly drip splits until 1 month prior to harvest.

viable_recommended_crops.target_soil_type: Highly porous sandy clay loam or amended medium black soil (Dindori, Nashik)

fertilizer_requirements.organic_manure: Vermicompost @ 10 tonnes/ha or sterilized cocopeat/manure beds
fertilizer_requirements.secondary_and_micronutrients: Calcium Nitrate @ 40 kg/ha (split weekly); Magnesium Sulphate @ 25 kg/ha
fertilizer_requirements.application_schedule_and_rationale: Equal weekly fertigation increments. High calcium inputs prevent blossom-end rot under variable vapor pressure deficits.

viable_recommended_crops.target_soil_type: Heavy reddish-brown clay loams with low percolation (Igatpuri, Peint, Surgana)

fertilizer_requirements.organic_manure: Green manuring with Sesbania aculeata incorporated before puddling
fertilizer_requirements.secondary_and_micronutrients: Zinc Sulphate @ 25 kg/ha basal in puddled soil (prevents Khaira disease)
fertilizer_requirements.application_schedule_and_rationale: 50% N, 100% P, and 100% K incorporated into puddled mud. 25% N at tillering (21-25 DAT) and 25% N at panicle initiation (45-50 DAT).

viable_recommended_crops.target_soil_type: Shallow, coarse, well-drained sandy loams (Malegaon, Yeola, Chandwad)

fertilizer_requirements.secondary_and_micronutrients: Zinc Sulphate @ 15 kg/ha
fertilizer_requirements.application_schedule_and_rationale: 50% N + 100% PK at sowing; remaining 50% N top-dressed 30 DAS following intercultivation and rainfall receipt.

viable_recommended_crops.growing_season: Perennial (Mrid Bahar: June flowering; Ambe Bahar: Feb flowering)
viable_recommended_crops.target_soil_type: Medium black to sandy loam soils with free drainage (pH 6.5 - 8.2)

fertilizer_requirements.secondary_and_micronutrients: Zinc Sulphate @ 0.5% + Boric Acid @ 0.3% foliar spray at fruit set
fertilizer_requirements.application_schedule_and_rationale: Delivered in two equal splits: at root pruning/stress breaking (May-June for Mrid Bahar), and during fruit development (September-October).

viable_recommended_crops.growing_season: Monsoon to Early Winter (Flowering: June-July; Harvest: Oct-Dec)
viable_recommended_crops.target_soil_type: Shallow, gravelly, rocky hillside soils and degraded marginal lands (Sinnar, Chandwad)

fertilizer_requirements.secondary_and_micronutrients: Zinc Sulphate @ 0.5% foliar spray at leaf emergence
fertilizer_requirements.application_schedule_and_rationale: 100% P and 50% NK applied at first monsoon rains (June); remaining 50% NK applied during fruit sizing (August-September).

viable_recommended_crops.growing_season: Rabi (Oct-Feb) & Late Kharif (Aug-Oct) [Rapid 25-35 day short cycles]
viable_recommended_crops.target_soil_type: Rich loams and medium black soils with rapid seedbed tilth (Nashik, Niphad)

fertilizer_requirements.secondary_and_micronutrients: Sulphur @ 15 kg/ha basal
fertilizer_requirements.application_schedule_and_rationale: Entire fertilizer applied as basal dose into broadcast beds before sowing. Fenugreek fixes atmospheric nitrogen after initial starter N boost.
